blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jackie Acuña, the lead host of Nxled’s non-stop block party this conference, was thrilled to go up against her former teammates-turned-Capital1 duo Vanie Gandler and Erika Santos on Saturday. Facing her ex-Cignal teammates, Acuña helped Nxled stay unbeaten in five games, scoring seven including three blocks in their 25-13, 25-20, 25-18 sweep of the skidding Capital1 in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Philsports Arena. “I miss having them as teammates on the court, but it’s also fun to play against them.
